name: Potion
description: Semantic recommendations: finds shows and movies with similar descriptions, using the small Potion model inside Tunarr.

accessGuide.reads: The titles, genres, tags and summaries of your shows and movies, which Tunarr hands it.
accessGuide.changes: Nothing in Tunarr. It keeps its own index of those titles.
accessGuide.connectsTo: Nothing. It runs entirely inside Tunarr.
accessGuide.downloads: The Potion model, tokenizer and calculation module (about 31 MB total) from this extension’s repository at install.
